methodology.scope: Single local host with real PostgreSQL; no production capacity claim
methodology.chain: orders -> catalog through Go middleware or one shared proxy; three business processes plus optional proxy
methodology.mix: 20% urgent, 20% normal, 60% batch; 64 stable synthetic cohort keys supplied by trusted loopback generator
methodology.limits: orders/inventory 12, catalog 6; reservations urgent 2, normal 1, batch 0; SQL pools 4; adaptive minimum 5, starting at service ceiling
methodology.cohorts: 128 buckets; 2s UTC rotation; one unmeasured stable-key probe between phases; no synchronized-clock guarantee
methodology.generator: Go open-loop, 4096 in-flight slots, 3s client timeout, no application retries; dispatch and arrival latency retained
methodology.priority_trust: Loopback is deliberately trusted in this isolated demo; remote-peer forgery is covered by Go integration tests
